notes.title: v2.2.2
notes.content:
The following updates have been made
- Fixed a bug that  cards cannot dismantle would be displayed on "Dismantle Selected Cards" and "Designated 'Don't Dismantle'" lists.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the dialogue from appearing when acquiring event rewards.
- Fixed other bugs with some UI displays.

notes.title: v2.2.1
notes.content:
The following updates have been made
- The UI and layout of Solo Mode have been improved.
- The filter function for deck editing has been enhanced.
- Mate can be set for each deck.
- Multiple wallpapers can be set to the home screen.
- Able to follow the opponent player after a duel.
- The Shop UI has been improved.
- The Duel UI has been improved.
- Other bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: v2.1.1
notes.content:
The following updates have been made
- A bug that occasionally caused the layout appears to be distorted during gameplay has been fixed.
- A bug that occasionally caused the game to forced close during gameplay has been fixed.

notes.title: v2.1.0
notes.content:
The following updates have been made
- A function has been added that allows you to check your deck during duels.
- The Disassembly Protection function has been added to the deck edit.
- The card Boost Generate function has been enhanced.
- The function for saving replays has been improved.
- Card activation effects during a duel have been added.
- The UI for various functions has been improved.
- Other bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: v2.0.0
notes.content:
The following updates have been made
- Added Casual Match as Practical Exam for MD certification.
- Added the ability to copy decks from DUEL LIVE.
- Added "Boost Generation" to generate 4 or more cards at once.
- The home screen UI has been improved.
- New card activation effects during duels have been added.
- Improved the duel UI.
- UI of various functions has been improved.
- Other bug fixes have been made.

notes.title: v1.9.3
notes.content:

notes.title: v1.5.1
notes.content:
The following updates have been made
- Improvements to prompts/messages related to card effect activations.
- New visual effect for when activating cards in Duels.
- Added Summon visual effect for Special Summons.
- Improvements to the UI and the time limit per turn in Duels.

notes.title: v1.4.2

notes.title: v1.4.1
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented.
- Improvements to prompts/messages related to card effect activations.
- New visual effect for when activating cards in Duels.
- Added Summon visual effect for Special Summons.
- Improvements to the UI in Duels.

notes.title: v1.3.2
notes.content:
The following updates have been made:

- Issue that duels may become unplayable is resolved and fixed UI bugs.

notes.title: v1.3.1
notes.content:
The following updates have been made

- Added a function to register in-game decks to the Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Database.

- Improved the display of card effect activation.

- Added card activation effects during duels.

- Added special summon effects.

- Improved the UI during duels.

- Added "Retry" function for SOLO mode.

- Added a function to edit decks in the Room Match.

notes.title: v1.2.0
notes.content:
The following updates have been made.

- Added casual match to the DUEL mode.

- Added new card effects.

- Added new summon animation.

- Added Enable/Disable summon animation only once per duel to Preference.

- Enabled saving your own replay in room matches.

- Added a function to select the viewpoint when replaying a duel replay in room matches.

- Search filter has been added to the Forbidden/Limited screen.

- Other bug fixes.
